title: Encryption, Plainly
hook: Encryption scrambles data with a key.
narration: Encryption scrambles data with a key.
HTTPS is that scramble in your browser.
Hold the cause in your head, then the effect.
Without the key, the message looks like noise.
This is the part most people skip. Do not skip it.
That is why cafe wifi is less scary than it used to be. Still, do not bank on sketchy pages.
If you can say why encryption, plainly works, you understood the film.
No gore. Just the model. School-safe.
The pictures today are a new lock world. Not yesterday's film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for encryption, plainly.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a different 3D film. New scene. New true fact.
